name: pygments-incremental-sessions-for-delegated-13ad
instr:
Pygments cannot incrementally tokenize delegated languages, emit stable indexed tokens as input arrives, or resume without replaying source. Implement incremental processing indistinguishable from `get_tokens_unprocessed` through lexer discovery and the command line.

Every `IncrementalLexerSession` from `start_incremental` accepts ordered chunks through `feed`, exposes its uncommitted suffix through `pending_length`, and allows one successful `finish`. Across every partition, emitted and final tokens match whole-input values, types, order, and absolute offsets. Emit only the longest prefix immune to every suffix.

An immutable, non-consuming `IncrementalCheckpoint` from `checkpoint` preserves lexer identity, source offset, pending state, and deterministic branching. `restore_incremental` reproduces them. `IncrementalSessionError` is a Exception. Invalid chunk types raise it; underlying lexer failures propagate. Incompatible restoration raises `IncrementalCheckpointError` before emission. Each failure terminates only that session without publishing unstable pending tokens; later operations raise `IncrementalSessionClosed`.

Apply this across the complete batch grammars of DObjdumpLexer, CSharpAspxLexer, EmailLexer, RagelRubyLexer, PythonConsoleLexer, SlashLexer, VelocityXmlLexer, and MozPreprocXulLexer.
